input.toml:
[[server]]
name = "work"
zuliprc = "~/.zuliprc"

[[server]]
name = "home"
zuliprc = "/etc/./zuliprc-home"
volume = 50

[defaults]
volume = 70
master_volume = 90
sound = "ping"
notify_channel_messages = true
flash = "top"
flash_color = "#FFAA00"
flash_seconds = 2
repeat = 3
sticky = true

[output]
player = ["play", "-q", "-V1"]
notifier = "/opt/bin/tn"
external_images = true

[focus]
mode = "mentions_and_dms"
quiet_mode = "mentions_and_dms"
quiet_hours = ["22:00-07:00", "9:05-9:30", "00:00-23:59"]

[[rule]]
description = "Pages"
match = "keyword"
keyword = "(?P<w>page)\\s+me"
priority = 5
sound = "sos"
volume = 100
banner = "title"
flash = "screen"
repeat = 2
repeat_every = 10

[[rule]]
match = "channel"
channel = ["ops", "deploy-.*"]
server = "work"

[[rule]]
name = "Old name"
match = "topic"
topic = "release"
channel = "eng"
enabled = false
stay = 30

[[rule]]
description = ""
match = "topic"
topic = "it's"

[[rule]]
description = "it's quoted"
match = "dm"
sound = "none"
min_gap = 60
batch_window = 5
repeat_boost = 20

[[rule]]
match = "mention"
sound = "/etc/hosts"

[[rule]]
match = "wildcard"
[[rule]]
match = "alert_word"
[[rule]]
match = "group_dm"
flash_seconds = 0.25
